name: crushing
//: concussive: a hard enough blow of this type to the head can knock you out.

name: cutting
//: depth: how much of the wound reaches what's deep inside (organs, internal bleeding, the brain). A slash opens you up; it doesn't reach your heart. dismember_single: a limb only comes off in one blow big enough to do it (a knife doesn't saw a leg off a nick at a time).

name: wrenching
//: Joint locks and tearing, from a hold (grapple.py). 'sudden': a part only comes off in one pull big enough to do it (cranking a human arm breaks it, it doesn't remove it). 'ignores_armor': worn armor doesn't help; natural toughness does.

name: crushing grip
//: Crushing what you hold: bear hugs, crushed hands, a throttled throat. Breaks things, never tears them off.
